summary: Iteration 20 — backend tests for new admin-tunable game settings (/api/admin/game-settings) and verification that the 4 games + Watch & Earn endpoints consume the overrides at request time. 18/18 pytest cases passed against the public preview URL. Validation, auth gating, persistence, override-application, and regression with defaults all behave correctly. The game_settings collection was reset to defaults at the end of the run, so user-visible state is clean.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2391 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Game-settings, admin routes and game endpoints should be split into dedicated modules (admin/game_settings.py, games/*.py) to keep the file maintainable.

admin_put_game_settings does light validation only (mega_chance and plinko_slots). Other fields (e.g. negative coin_daily_cap, watch_reward_min > watch_reward_max, hl_reward_streak_3 negative) are accepted as-is and could produce broken in-game behaviour. Consider Pydantic validators or explicit checks per field.
Dead code: lines 898-901 (`if cycle_used >= 5: pass`) in tasks/watch are a no-op left over from the refactor — should be removed; the real check happens after settings load.

get_game_settings is called once per request inside each game endpoint, which is fine for now, but if traffic grows the single-doc lookup could be cached in-process with a short TTL since changes only happen via admin PUT.

PUT /api/admin/game-settings returns 400 'No fields to update' when payload is empty/all-None, which is correct, but the OpenAPI schema doesn't document the validation error shape — consider a typed error response.

success_rate.backend: 100% (18/18 after one transient retry; rerun was 18/18 first-shot)

seed_data_creation: Every test creates a fresh device-auth user via POST /api/auth/device (unique device_id) and uses the conftest admin_session fixture which inserts an is_admin=True user directly into Mongo. All TEST_ users, sessions and transactions are cleaned up in fixture teardown. A module-scoped autouse fixture creates a final temporary admin and PUTs the defaults dict back into db.game_settings so the live preview app shows expected limits/rewards after the test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iteration20_game_settings.py for regression around admin game-settings and override-application. The DEFAULTS dict at the top mirrors _GAME_SETTINGS_DEFAULTS in server.py — keep them in sync if new settings fields are added. One observed flakiness: the preview ingress occasionally drops a single request mid-suite (saw one ConnectTimeout to taskmint-import-1.preview.emergentagent.com on first run); retrying the affected test passes immediately. If a test errors with ConnectTimeout, re-run it once before treating as a real failure.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no defects found in this iteration. The Treasure-Hunt 'stuck on Loading…' bug reported by the user was already fixed before this run; the backend treasure/state endpoint returns the correct payload (verified in test_treasure_default and test_treasure_total_days_override) so the FE fix (renaming the lucide-react-native Map import) is consistent with the working backend contract.
